firstYear: A three-year degree. The core subjects include Programming 1 and 2, Discrete Mathematics, Mathematics 1, Web Systems, networks, databases and communication for IT professionals, building towards data structures and algorithms, theory of computing science, advanced algorithms and a final capstone project. It can also be taken through the UTS IDeA cadetship, where you work in industry while you study.
notThis: The listed core leans towards theory: discrete maths, theory of computing science and advanced algorithms, alongside programming, networks and databases. A separate four-year honours version exists for students who want research.
